meta.name: competitor-pages
meta.description: Competitor page gap analysis — take a query you want to win and the pages currently outranking you, and produce a concrete brief on what to add or change to compete. Compares content depth and coverage (subtopics they cover that you don't), structure (headings, format, tables, media), search-intent match, E-E-A-T signals, schema/rich-result eligibility, internal linking, and on-page optimization — across your page vs. the top-ranking competitors. Use this skill whenever the user wants to know why a competitor outranks them on a specific query, what a top-ranking page does better, a content-gap analysis against specific competitor URLs, or a brief to beat a specific SERP. Trigger on: "why does competitor X outrank me", "content gap analysis", "competitor page analysis", "what does the top result have that I don't", "how do I beat this page", "analyze competitor pages", "SERP gap", "compete for [keyword]". For seed keyword discovery use /keyword-research; for a content calendar use /content-planner.

copy.tagline: 分析竞争对手页面，生成内容优化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想知道为什么竞争对手排名更高，以及如何改进自己的页面。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze competitor pages and generate content improvement briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know why competitors outrank you and how to improve your page.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的网页与排名靠前的竞争对手页面，找出内容、结构、搜索意图、E-E-A-T、结构化数据、内部链接等方面的差距，并生成一份具体的优化简报。
howto.when: 当你询问为什么竞争对手排名比你高、要求进行内容差距分析、或想知道如何超越某个搜索结果页面时触发。

say.text: 为什么竞争对手A在关键词“B”上排名比我高？
say.note: Claude 会对比你的页面和对手页面，列出差距。

say.text: 帮我做内容差距分析，对手URL是X和Y。
say.note: Claude 会抓取页面并生成缺失子主题列表。

say.text: 如何击败这个搜索结果页面？
say.note: Claude 会给出格式、子主题、结构化数据等建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze your page against top-ranking competitor pages, identify gaps in content depth, structure, search intent, E-E-A-T signals, schema, internal linking, and on-page optimization, and produce a concrete brief to beat the SERP.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask why a competitor outranks you, request a content gap analysis, or want to know how to beat a specific search result page.

say_en.text: Why does competitor X outrank me for keyword Y?
say_en.note: Claude compares your page and competitor pages, listing gaps.

say_en.text: Do a content gap analysis with competitor URLs A and B.
say_en.note: Claude fetches pages and generates missing subtopics.

say_en.text: How do I beat this SERP?
say_en.note: Claude provides format, subtopics, schema, etc.
